 Fort Bend County District Court
 Cause No. 2025-CV-0010
 Shirley Rhodes, Plaintiff, v. Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance, Defendant
 Defendant's Original Answer
Date:
2-24-25
Counsel for defendant:
Marilyn Fox, Ashford & Lyle LLP
Defendant generally denies each and every allegation contained in Plaintiff's Original Petition and demands strict
proof thereof by a preponderance of the evidence, as required by the Texas Rules of Civil Procedure.
Subject to and without waiving the foregoing general denial, Defendant asserts the following affirmative defenses.
First, Plaintiff's alleged injuries and damages were proximately caused, in whole or in part, by Plaintiff's own
negligence. The evidence will show that Plaintiff entered the intersection against a traffic control device or failed to
yield the right-of-way at the time of the collision. Under Chapter 33 of the Texas Civil Practice and Remedies Code,
any recovery must be reduced in prooprtion to Plaintiff's percentage of responsibility, and Plaintiff may be barred from
recovery if that percentage exceeds fifty percent.
Second, the collision was caused by the negligence of a third party over whom Defendant had no control. Defendant
invokes the responsible third party designation procedure under Section 33.004 and reserves the right to join such
persons.
Third, Defendant asserts that Plaintiff failed to mitigate damages by unreasonably delaying or forgoing reasonable
medical care, and that any recovery for medical expenses must be limited to amounts acutally paid or incurred under
Section 41.0105.
</page>

  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
